posts.text: Requiring photo ID to vote is a common-sense measure that most Americans support, across demographic & partisan lines. This constitutional amendment also enables Ohio lawmakers to expressly apply the photo ID requirement to ALL ballots, including mail-in ballots (which I would sign into law and which most Ohioans support).
